turns.replyText:
2:42 PM. You said:

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

02:42 PM

I’m sorry this is stressful. Once an order has already shipped, the shipping address cannot be changed by us directly. You can check the carrier’s tracking page with your tracking number and contact the carrier, as some carriers may still offer a redirection or a pickup point depending on their options. If the carrier cannot redirect it and you believe the package cannot be delivered at all, I can pass your request to our team. Please share your email address so a person can follow up.
